messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::厳粛な哀悼のイサンに振動付与などの専用効果を与える、強化: A 5-Coin E.G.O that distributes attacks across multiple targets and chiefly serves as an upgrade for Lobotomy E.G.O:: Solemn Lament Yi Sang, granting him special benefits including Tremor application.
messages.パッシブ(解析Ⅱで解放): 哀悼のイサンは基本スキルの的中時に振動2が付き、沈潜: **Passive (unlocked at Threadspin Ⅱ)**: While equipped at this tier, Solemn Lament Yi Sang's Base Skills inflict 2 Tremor on hit, once per skill; both the Identity and his Base Skills count as inflicting Sinking and Tremor. The following additional benefits activate from the turn after using the E.G.O: his ammunition cap for The Living & The Departed increases by 10. After Reloading, restores 10 SP and Discards 1 Base Attack Skill, up to 2 times per turn. Equipping a defense skill also restores 10 SP at Turn End.
messages.蝶の付与と消耗: Ⅰ〜Ⅳコインの的中で対象にランダムに蝶を付与し(1・2・2・3: **Applying and spending Butterfly**: Coins Ⅰ–Ⅳ randomly apply Butterfly to their targets on hit, in amounts of 1, 2, 2, and 3. Coin Ⅴ consumes all of his own ammunition, The Living & The Departed, inflicts 3 Sinking and 3 Tremor, and triggers Tremor Burst. Butterfly on the target and Yi Sang's own ammunition are separate resources.
messages.解析で伸びる火力: 解析ⅢでⅤコインに、対象の全蝶に応じた憂鬱ダメージが加わる。: **Damage from Threadspin upgrades**: Threadspin Ⅲ adds Gloom damage on Coin Ⅴ based on all Butterfly on the target. Threadspin Ⅳ adds Gloom Fragility and Gloom Resist Down to Coin Ⅳ, plus Sinking Count increases on Coins Ⅰ–Ⅳ.
messages.哀悼イサン専用の効果: 使用するイサン人格が哀悼なら、攻撃前に(憂鬱共鳴数+1): **Benefits exclusive to Solemn Lament Yi Sang**: Before attacking, that Identity gains ammunition equal to Gloom Resonance + 1, up to 7, then Reloads after attacking. Reloading costs SP equal to (30 − remaining ammunition) ÷ 2.
messages.解析Ⅱで解放されるパッシブが主な価値で、スキルは強化パーツのおまけ程度に使うと考: The passive unlocked at Threadspin Ⅱ is its main value. Treat the attack itself as a secondary benefit of activating this upgrade.
messages.蝶は対象に付けて使うので、敵1体を集中して狙う方が伸びると考えられる。蝶を使い切: Since Butterfly is applied to targets, focusing on one enemy can improve the payoff. The skill expends ammunition and Reloads, so use it with SP to spare.
messages.全コインが破壊不能コイン。マッチ威力は6〜16(解析Ⅳは6〜21)で、解析Ⅳでは: All Coins are Unbreakable. Its Clash range is 6–16, or 6–21 at Threadspin Ⅳ. Threadspin Ⅳ also adds +1 Clash Power per 4 combined Sinking Potency and Butterfly on the main target, up to +4.
messages.必要資源は怠惰1・憂鬱4・傲慢2、精神消耗は覚醒20・侵蝕25・OC38。: Costs 1 Sloth, 4 Gloom, and 2 Pride. SP cost: 20 Awakening, 25 Corrosion, 38 Overclock.
messages.耐性は暴食・嫉妬が脆弱(×2)、憂鬱が耐性(×0.5)。: Sin resistances: Fatal to Gluttony and Envy (×2); Ineffective against Gloom (×0.5).
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放され、哀悼のイサンに振動付与などの専用効果が付く。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive: equipping it grants Solemn Lament Yi Sang Tremor application; the other listed benefits begin the turn after E.G.O use.
messages.Ⅲ: Ⅴコインに蝶に応じた憂鬱ダメージが加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds Butterfly-based Gloom damage to Coin Ⅴ.
messages.Ⅳ: 憂鬱脆弱・憂鬱耐性弱化、コイン威力+3、マッチ威力強化が加わり、大きく強化: **Ⅳ**: Adds Gloom Fragility and Gloom Resist Down, raises Coin Power from +2 to +3, and adds the Clash Power condition, substantially improving the E.G.O.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::厳粛な哀悼: このE.G.Oの専用効果(蝶・再装填・振動: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: Solemn Lament](persona:0110)**: The Identity that receives this E.G.O's special Butterfly, Reload, and Tremor benefits. Gloom S2 and defense help supply its resources.
messages.開花E.G.O::壇香梅: 沈潜と振動を扱う人格で、このE.G.Oと系統が噛み合: **[Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush](persona:0104)**: Uses both Sinking and Tremor, matching this E.G.O's effects.
